list.title: Reports
list.subtitle: Reports are snapshots frozen from the project's records as of a date. Opening or downloading one re-checks your current access, section by section.
list.caption: Report snapshots
list.emptyHint: Generate a report to freeze the current records as a snapshot.

generate.title: Generate a report
generate.description: The report is built now from the records you can read and frozen as a snapshot. Later changes to the records do not change it.
generate.workstreamHint: Weekly and look-ahead reports can be limited to one workstream.
generate.meetingNone: There is no meeting you can read in this project.
generate.committeeKindsHint: Committee packs and minutes are committee records: they are generated by the PMO secretariat or the project manager.

kindHints.executive_summary: One page: status dimensions, gates and the next gate, delays, decisions needed and escalations.
kindHints.committee_pack: Overview, gates, delays, plan and milestones, Day-1 readiness, risks and issues, financials within your finance clearance, decisions, actions and evidence.
kindHints.workstream_weekly: Accepted updates, the 2 / 4 / 8-week look-ahead, overdue items, risks and issues, and escalations.
kindHints.look_ahead: What is due in the next 2, 4 and 8 weeks, and what is overdue.
kindHints.day1_readiness: Day-1 readiness by site and check, open blockers, and the gates.
kindHints.tsa_exit: Transitional services: exit status, services at risk and services expired without a resolution.
kindHints.jv_closing: JV signing, closing and conditions precedent, and the gates.
kindHints.health_data_quality: Project status, data quality and the KPI values, with the changes since the previous snapshot.
kindHints.minutes: Minutes of one meeting: attendance, decisions and the actions arising.

integrity.mismatch: Content hash mismatch — the stored content differs from its hash

detail.exportNotAllowed: You can open this report but your role cannot export it.

changes.title: Changes since the previous snapshot
changes.caption: Figures that changed since the previous snapshot
changes.none: No figure changed since the previous snapshot (in the sections you can read in both).
changes.first: This is the first snapshot of this type and scope: there is nothing to compare with yet.
changes.unavailable: The previous snapshot is outside your current access, so no comparison is shown.

exports.title: Files
exports.description: Files are rendered by the background worker from this snapshot, stored inside the platform and downloadable only by you after your access is checked again. Nothing is sent anywhere.
exports.dialogDescription: The file prints exactly this snapshot, in the language you choose, with only the sections you may read.

formatHints.xlsx: Excel workbook, one sheet per section; text that looks like a formula is stored as plain text.
formatHints.pdf: PDF document with embedded fonts and the classification on every page.
formatHints.pptx: PowerPoint presentation, one slide per section (committee pack).

exports.requested: Export requested — the file appears in the list when it is ready
exports.caption: Your files of this snapshot
exports.empty: You have not exported this snapshot yet.

errors.requester_access_revoked: Cancelled: your access changed before the file was published.
errors.renderer_unavailable: Failed: this file format cannot be produced on this server.
errors.render_failed: Failed: the file could not be produced. Request it again or contact support.

kpis.title: KPI catalogue
kpis.subtitle: The proposed KPIs of the programme with all their attributes. A definition stays a proposal until it is confirmed; values are computed now from the records you can read, and a KPI without source records has no value.
kpis.caption: KPI catalogue
kpis.definitionsRestricted: KPI definitions are finance records: you need finance read access in the whole project to see the catalogue.
kpis.empty: No KPI is defined for this project.

states.no_calculator: No calculator — see the manual observations in Finance

bi.title: BI access
bi.subtitle: Read-only database views that a BI tool (for example Power BI) reads with a restricted BI database account. Only the project sponsor lists a project; demo projects are never readable.
bi.exposed: Listed: the BI account can read this project in the views
bi.notExposed: Not listed: the BI account cannot read this project
bi.demo: Demo project: never readable through the BI views, whatever the grant
bi.connectionNotVerified: Not verified — the platform cannot see the BI tool and never reports it as connected.
bi.docs: The views, their columns and the database rules are described in the architecture documentation (BI views).
bi.grantTitle: List this project for the BI views
bi.grantDescription: The restricted BI account will read this project's rows in the views, up to the classification below (never above your own clearance). A change is a withdrawal and a new grant; both are recorded in the activity history.
bi.granted: Project listed for the BI views
bi.revokeTitle: Withdraw the project from the BI views
bi.revokeDescription: The BI account stops reading this project from its next query. The grant stays in the history.
bi.revoked: Project withdrawn from the BI views
bi.caption: BI grants of this project
bi.empty: The project has never been listed for the BI views.

refusals.export_format_unavailable: This file format cannot be produced on this server (its renderer is not installed). Choose another format.
refusals.meeting_required: Choose the meeting whose minutes are reported.
refusals.meeting_not_applicable: Only minutes refer to a meeting.
refusals.workstream_not_applicable: Only weekly and look-ahead reports can be limited to a workstream.
refusals.nothing_to_report: Nothing in this report is within your current access, so no snapshot was generated.
refusals.export_not_ready: The file is not ready yet.
refusals.export_integrity: The stored file does not match its checksum and was not delivered. Request a new file.
refusals.bi_above_clearance: A BI grant cannot exceed your own clearance.
refusals.bi_grant_active: The project already has an active BI grant: withdraw it first.

meta.demoBanner: Demo — synthetic sandbox data, not real Mobily information
meta.withheld: Outside your current access — not shown
meta.partialView: Some sections are outside your current access and are not included.
meta.snapshotNote: Report snapshot: figures are frozen as of the date above and do not change when records change.

sections.delays: What is delayed and the impact
sections.closing: JV signing, closing and conditions precedent

tables.next_gate_open_criteria: Open mandatory criteria of the next gate

figures.open_tasks_without_owner: Open tasks without an accountable owner
figures.open_tasks_without_finish_date: Open tasks without a planned finish
figures.workstreams_without_fresh_update: Workstreams without a fresh accepted update

report.accepted_updates_only: Only accepted updates are used; drafts, submitted and returned updates are not.
report.blocker_makes_site_red: A single open blocker makes a site red whatever its percentage.
report.closing_needs_verified_cps: A closing needs every blocking condition verified or validly waived.
report.expired_unresolved_not_exit: An expired-unresolved TSA is not an exit: it stays escalated until an approved option is recorded.
report.finance_within_clearance: Financial records are included only up to the generator’s finance clearance.
report.internal_approval_label: Internal electronic approval — not a legally certified signature.
report.kpi_proposals: KPI definitions are proposals until confirmed; values are computed from the records at the as-of date. A KPI without records has no value.
report.look_ahead_windows: Windows on business dates: 2 weeks {from} – {to2}, 4 weeks to {to4}, 8 weeks to {to8}.
report.no_approved_baseline: No approved baseline: slips are measured from the planned dates.
report.stale_after_days: An accepted update older than {days} days is stale (proposed window, to be approved).
report.tsa_warning_window: At risk: breached, expired-unresolved, or ending within {days} days (until {until}) without an accepted replacement (proposed window).
report.minutes_approved_internal: Minutes approved by internal electronic approval.
report.money_not_summed_across_currencies: Amounts are shown per currency and unit scale; they are never added across currencies or units.
report.money_single_group: All amounts are in one currency and unit scale.

kpi.mixed_currency_no_single_value: Several currencies or unit scales: no single value without an approved conversion basis.
kpi.open_blockers_red: Open blockers make the readiness red whatever the percentage.
kpi.partial_sources: Some sources are outside the generator’s access and are not counted.
kpi.planned_date_used_without_baseline: No baseline date for some milestones: the planned date is used.
kpi.schedule_incomplete: Some open critical milestones lack dates.
kpi.stale_window_proposed: Stale-after window is a proposal (14 days).
kpi.tsa_warning_window_proposed: TSA warning window is a proposal (90 days).
kpi.weights_not_approved_count_based: Not every weight is approved: each deliverable counts once.

sources.data_quality_registers: Task, milestone, deliverable, workstream and update registers
